name: Checkbox
description: A checkbox and its label, drawn as Flutter's on both platforms. Alone it sends a boolean.

label.description: The text beside the box, in regular weight.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

defaultSelected.description: Starts at this value; the merchant changes it.

isSelected.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree.

isIndeterminate.description: "Some selected". The look stays until the tree changes.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.
